progression_rule: Hit the TOP of the rep/hold range with clean form for 2 consecutive sessions -> move to the next exercise via progression_to. Restart at the BOTTOM of the new exercise's range.
regression_rule: Miss the BOTTOM of the rep/hold range for 2 consecutive sessions, OR form consistently breaks per that exercise's common_faults -> step back via regression_of for 1-2 weeks, then retest.
deload_rule: Every 4-6 weeks, cut volume by ~40% (drop a set, or cut sessions to 2 instead of 4-5 exercises) regardless of how progression is going. This is separate from progression/regression and happens on a fixed schedule.
assessment_use: is_assessment exercises are the checkpoint moves (strict pull-up, full front lever, pistol squat, freestanding handstand hold, etc). Re-test these every 4-8 weeks to decide whether to shift the whole rotation_group up a tier, not just one exercise.
